# Agentic Media Lab

> Which skill, renderer and model to use when a coding agent makes your video - with runs you can repeat. Records: 155 (58 tool, 25 model, 72 source, 0 recipe). Concepts: 35. Pages: 3. Size: about 151792 tokens (estimate, characters / 4).

## Entry points

- [Index](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/INDEX.md): concept tree with counts and the hub size
- [Catalog](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/README.md): every record by kind, inactive records listed separately
- [Data schema](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/SCHEMA.md): Use this page when you need the exact record fields, allowed values, id rules or how the evidence badge is derived.
- [Glossary](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/docs/glossary.md): Use this page when a term in the hub is unclear or you need a concept id.
- [All records as JSON lines](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/index/records.jsonl): the full machine dump
- [README.md](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/README.md): what the hub is
- [AGENTS.md](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/AGENTS.md): how agents query and extend the hub

## Records

- [Wan 3.0](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/alibaba__wan.md): model, quoted-primary. It led the Artificial Analysis text-to-video board on 2026-11-12, and its 1080P list price is lower than Seedance 2.5 or FLUX 3 Video at ...
- [FLUX 3](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/black-forest-labs__flux-3.md): model, quoted-primary. Its pricing page states video rates for four resolution bands, whether audio is included, and the longest output.
- [Dreamina Seedance 2.5](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/bytedance__seedance.md): model, quoted-primary. It ranked first on the Artificial Analysis image-to-video board read 2026-11-12 and gives the longest single clip found here (30 s).
- [Nano Banana (Gemini image models)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/google__nano-banana.md): model, quoted-primary. Code that calls imagen-4.0-* on the Gemini API stopped working on 2026-08-17; Nano Banana 2.1 is the named replacement.
- [Kokoro-82M](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/hexgrad__kokoro.md): model, quoted-primary. It gives an agent a free, local narration voice with commercial use allowed, small enough to run beside a video model.
- [Z-Image](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/tongyi-mai__z-image.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the small, permissive image model with published memory numbers on a 64 GB Apple Silicon Mac, which makes it the default for local ...

It is the closest paper to the reader's job, a 12-second multi-shot ad, and its judge rubric scores the hook in the first 1-2 seconds.

It is the only standards-body number found for a louder-than-broadcast streaming mix, the case most short clips fall into.

- [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/w3.org__tr__wcag22.md): source, quoted-primary. It gives a pass or fail number for caption and title contrast and for flashing, which a frame-sampling check can test on a rendered clip.
- [TikTok Community Guidelines - Integrity and Authenticity (Edited Media and AIGC)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/www.tiktok.com__community-guidelines__en__integrity-authenticity.md): source, quoted-primary. It states when a generated clip must carry the AI label and what happens to unlabelled realistic AI content.
- [PySceneDetect](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/breakthrough__pyscenedetect.md): tool, quoted-primary. Run on a render, it gives the real cut times and shot lengths, so a review step can check pacing and catch accidental cuts or a missing ...
- [generative-media-skills](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/calesthio__generative-media-skills.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the only candidate found that covers caption limits, delivery specs and character continuity in one place, with a caption validator ...
- [claude-code-video-toolkit](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/digitalsamba__claude-code-video-toolkit.md): tool, quoted-primary. Its design rules address the most common amateur tells: wrapped titles, drifting alignment, colour changes with no reason.
- [FFmpeg](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/ffmpeg__ffmpeg.md): tool, quoted-primary. An agent can finish or assemble a clip with FFmpeg alone, and most render failures that reach the reader are FFmpeg input mismatches.
- [bb](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/get-bb__bb.md): tool, quoted-primary. The closest fit found for a single developer who wants a scheduled Claude Code or Codex run on their own Mac, with run history and a ...
- [whisper.cpp](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/ggml-org__whisper.cpp.md): tool, quoted-primary. It gives an agent a local transcript with timestamps for captions, on the Mac GPU, from one command.
- [GSAP](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/greensock__gsap.md): tool, quoted-primary. Most HTML video an agent writes moves with GSAP, so its licence travels with every HyperFrames clip.
- [HyperFrames](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/heygen-com__hyperframes.md): tool, quoted-primary. One of the two renderers most agent-made video runs on, and its skill carries numeric motion, review and loudness rules.
- [ffmpeg-skill](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/kajisho5__ffmpeg-skill.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the clearest delivery skill found: platform checks on the output file, numbers in the report, and a contact sheet the agent must view ...
- [Manim Community Edition](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/manimcommunity__manim.md): tool, quoted-primary. The usual route for diagram and equation animation written by an agent in Python, with a one-flag way to get the last frame as a PNG.
- [MFLUX](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/mflux-community__mflux.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the shortest documented path from a coding agent to a local image or upscale on Apple Silicon: one shell command per image, no server.
- [mlx-whisper](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/ml-explore__mlx-examples__whisper.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the pip-installable way for an agent on a Mac to get a transcript file without compiling anything.
- [motion-graphics (Mort1d)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/mort1d__motion-graphics-skills.md): tool, quoted-primary. It fixes a master spec, forbids copying reference material, and makes the agent critique until every score is 8 or more before the final ...
- [OpenRouter video generation API](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/openrouter__video-generation.md): tool, quoted-secondary. The models endpoint is a machine-readable price and limits list an agent can read before choosing a model, without a key.
- [Remotion](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/remotion-dev__remotion.md): tool, quoted-primary. The most established code renderer an agent can drive locally, and the one most skills target. Its licence is the first thing to check ...
- [Remotion Agent Skills](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/remotion-dev__skills.md): tool, quoted-primary. The reference skills for the other dominant renderer. They state support for Codex and Cursor as well as Claude Code.
- [Runway Dev API](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/runwayml__runway-api.md): tool, quoted-secondary. One key and one MCP connector reach most of the hosted video models in this hub, and the price table is in plain text.
- [Code2Video](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/showlab__code2video.md): tool, quoted-primary. The reference pipeline for agent-written explainer video in code, and the base that later Manim checking work (SGA) is measured on.

## Optional

- [ACE-Step 1.5](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/ace-step__ace-step.md): model, quoted-primary. It gives a local soundtrack with a stated permission for commercial use of the output, and its macOS scripts use MLX.
- [HappyHorse](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/alibaba__happyhorse.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the cheapest way found here to try an Alibaba video model at 480P, with a small free quota.
- [FLUX 3 Image Klein](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/black-forest-labs__flux-3-image-klein.md): model, quoted-secondary. It does generation and multi-reference editing in one model with measured memory on a 64 GB Mac, but its licence caps paid work by the ...
- [SeedVR2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/bytedance-seed__seedvr.md): model, quoted-primary. Upscaling is a cheap last step to make a local clip or still look finished, and mflux ships an MLX upscale command for it.
- [Seedream 5.0](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/bytedance__seedream.md): model, quoted-primary. The flash id is one of the cheapest first-party image prices found here, and input images are free on most ids.
- [Gemini Omni Flash](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/google__gemini-omni-flash.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the replacement Google names for Veo 3.1 on the Gemini API.
- [Veo 3.1](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/google__veo-3.1.md): model, quoted-primary. Code and skills that call Veo through the Gemini API need to migrate.
- [HeyGen Video 1](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/heygen__heygen-video-1.md): model, quoted-primary. It led the silent text-to-video board on Artificial Analysis read 2026-11-12, and it returns dialogue, ambience and effects with the clip.
- [LTX-2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/lightricks__ltx-2.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the open video model with the most documented Mac routes: the official PyTorch code on MPS, mlx-video for LTX-2 and 2.3, and Draw ...
- [Luma Ray3.2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/lumalabs__ray.md): model, quoted-primary. Native HDR and 16-bit EXR export are rare among hosted models and matter when the clip is composited with live footage.
- [MiniMax H3](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/minimaxai__minimax-h3.md): model, quoted-primary. A leading open-weights video model whose licence does not cover several major regions.
- [GPT Image 2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/openai__gpt-image.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the image model many agent skills call by default; its price is in tokens, so the per-image cost must come from the calculator.
- [Sora 2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/openai__sora-2.md): model (archived), quoted-primary. Many guides and skills still call it. Anything that depends on the Videos API no longer runs.
- [Qwen-Image](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/qwen__qwen-image.md): model, quoted-primary. It runs on a 64 GB Mac with published timings, but version 2.1 is licensed for research and evaluation only.
- [Runway Aleph 2.0](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/runwayml__aleph.md): model, quoted-primary. It edits an existing video by prompt, the step after generation when one shot is almost right.
- [Runway Gen-4.5](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/runwayml__gen-4.5.md): model, quoted-primary. It is one of two models Runway lets export ProRes, PNG sequences and HDR, which matters when the output goes into a grading or compositing ...
- [Vimoo 1.0](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/vimoo-ai__vimoo-1.0.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the one open video model whose own vendor publishes an Apple Silicon package with a CLI, under Apache 2.0.
- [Wan 2.2](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/wan-ai__wan2.2.md): model, quoted-primary. It is the main Apache-2.0 video family with a documented MLX route on a Mac, so client work carries no revenue cap.
- [Grok Imagine](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/model/xai__grok-imagine.md): model, quoted-primary. The Lite variant gives video with lip-synced speech from $0.02 per second, the lowest first-party video price found here.
- [TikTok Ads - Creative best practices for performance ads](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/ads.tiktok.com__help__article__creative-best-practices.md): source, quoted-primary. It is the only first-party page found that puts numbers on hook timing and on-screen text speed for short-form.
- [Artificial Analysis Video Arena: text-to-video and image-to-video leaderboards](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/artificialanalysis.ai__video__leaderboard__text-to-video.md): source, quoted-primary. It is the most used public ranking of hosted video models, and it shows rank ranges, so close models can be read as ties.
- [MovieAgent: Automated Movie Generation via Multi-Agent CoT Planning](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2503.07314.md): source, quoted-primary. An early multi-agent movie pipeline (March 2025) that later systems (ViMax, Co-Director) use as a baseline and beat.
- [VBench-2.0: benchmark suite for intrinsic faithfulness](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2503.21755.md): source, quoted-secondary. Many pipeline papers in this lane (CoAgent, MovieAgent) report VBench-family numbers, so a reader needs to know what they do and do not ...
- [ViStoryBench: benchmark suite for story visualization](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2505.24862.md): source, quoted-secondary. The standard test for the storyboard-image stage of a pipeline, before any video model runs; Google's Co-Director post reports results on ...
- [CoAgent: Collaborative Planning and Consistency Agent for Coherent Video Generation](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2512.22536.md): source, quoted-primary. It reports how often the verify-and-regenerate loop fires and how many retries it needs, which is the number to budget against.
- [WorldJen: end-to-end multi-dimensional benchmark for generative video models](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2605.03475.md): source, unverified. It names a specific weakness of VBench-2.0 that matters if a pipeline uses a VLM as its own checker: yes-bias and low-resolution frames.
- [Under the Hood of SKILL.md: Semantic Supply-chain Attacks on AI Agent Skill Registry](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2605.11418.md): source, quoted-primary. It shows that the description text of a skill decides whether an agent picks it and whether a registry blocks it, so a well-worded copy can ...
- [PRISM: benchmark for programmatic spatial-temporal reasoning](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2605.19382.md): source, quoted-secondary. It puts a number on why an agent must look at its Manim render: code that runs is often laid out wrong.
- [ViMax: Agentic Video Generation (arXiv 2606.07649)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2606.07649.md): source, quoted-primary. It names the fields a shot spec should carry and reports measured cost and quality for keyframe best-of-k, which sets a default for a ...
- [SGA: Plug&Play Geometric Verification for Educational Video Synthesis](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/arxiv.org__abs__2607.18116.md): source, quoted-primary. A cheaper check than a VLM looking at rendered frames for the commonest Manim defect, overlapping labels, with runtime numbers.

It gives an ordered list a review step can use to decide which cut to keep when two rules conflict.
- [Threads API - Posts](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/developers.facebook.com__docs__threads__posts.md): source, quoted-primary. Threads has the highest daily cap of the Meta surfaces and a 5-minute video limit, and its AI flag is documented with what it does not ...

Facebook Page Reels have a lower daily cap and a shorter maximum length than Instagram Reels, which matters when one render goes to both.
- [Bluesky docs - Uploading Video](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/docs.bsky.app__docs__tutorials__video.md): source, quoted-primary. Bluesky needs no app review, but it does state account-level video limits without giving the numbers.
- [Mastodon docs - Posting (attachments) and Instance media configuration](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/docs.joinmastodon.org__user__posting.md): source, quoted-primary. Mastodon limits are set per server, so an agent should read them from the instance instead of hard-coding them.

- [HyperFrames vs Remotion research note (GenMotion)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__haxzie__genmotion__blob__main__docs__research__hyperframes-remotion.md.md): source, quoted-secondary. The only source found that says how HyperFrames capture differs on macOS, which is the reader's machine.
- [Material 3 motion tokens (material-web, _md-sys-motion.scss)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/source/github.com__material-components__material-web__blob__main__tokens__versions__latest__sass___md-sys-motion.scss.md): source, quoted-primary. An agent animating UI-style titles can use these values as named durations and curves instead of one default ease for everything.

- [MCP for Blender](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/ahujasid__mcp-for-blender.md): tool, quoted-primary. The working path for 3D shots driven by an agent, with a built-in way for the agent to see its own frames.

- [video-use](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/browser-use__video-use.md): tool, quoted-primary. The clearest example of a skill that inspects its own output at every cut before handing it over.
- [ComfyUI](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/comfy-org__comfyui.md): tool, quoted-primary. Many model vendors ship ComfyUI workflows first, and comfy-cli gives an agent a command to run them locally on a Mac.

- [smooth-animation-skill](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/flchntc__smooth-animation-skill.md): tool, quoted-primary. It replaces 'looks choppy' with a measured number and a fixed order of fixes, and it re-measures the final file.
- [Postiz](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/gitroomhq__postiz-app.md): tool, quoted-primary. It is the self-hostable scheduler an agent can drive over MCP or its API, so one render can be queued to several platforms.

- [VMAF (libvmaf)](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/netflix__vmaf.md): tool, quoted-primary. It measures what an export step lost against the master, and the phone model fits clips watched on a phone.
- [html-video](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/nexu-io__html-video.md): tool, quoted-primary. A wrapper that drives Claude Code or Codex as a subprocess and ships 21 templates; only the HyperFrames engine works so far.

- [OpenMontage](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/openmontageinc__openmontage.md): tool, quoted-primary. Its reviewer skill makes every critical finding carry a concrete fix and bounds revision rounds, and its typography skill has per-platform ...
- [Replicate API and MCP server](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/replicate__replicate.md): tool, quoted-primary. An agent in Claude Code can search Replicate's catalogue and run a model by name without hand-written client code.
- [OpenDirector](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/seme-org__open-director.md): tool, quoted-primary. Shows the reference-image route to character consistency in a small, readable stack, and names the model setting that silently breaks it.
- [Temporal](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/temporalio__temporal.md): tool, quoted-primary. The heaviest option here, but the one with explicit, documented rules for overlapping and late runs.
- [Trigger.dev](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/triggerdotdev__trigger.dev.md): tool, quoted-primary. Waitpoint tokens give code-first approval: a render task waits for an 'approved' or 'rejected' payload before it publishes.
- [video-shotcraft](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/vincentwei1021__video-shotcraft.md): tool, quoted-primary. It makes the reviewer a different agent from the maker, which is the strongest review-loop rule found so far.
- [Windmill](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/windmill-labs__windmill.md): tool, quoted-primary. Its suspend-until-approval step is a run-time human gate in the free edition, which fits a 'render, then wait for my OK, then publish' flow.
- [MoviePy](https://tp9imka.github.io/agentic-media-lab/catalog/tool/zulko__moviepy.md): tool, quoted-primary. Easy for an agent to script in Python, but agent training data is full of v1 code that v2 broke.
